snippet.title: Delverium - Multiplayer Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
New gameplay trailer highlighting the latest development changes including Online Multiplayer and a Huge Art Update!

Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710040/Delverium

Delverium is a survival sandbox fantasy adventure for 1-8 players blending exploration, farming, crafting, settlement building, and dungeon crawling in a vast procedurally-generated world. Players can gather resources, build shelters, tend crops, recruit NPC's, explore the land and venture into the unknown to uncover a deeper secret.

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/BBzrVM4c9T
